name: What is involved in the roof replacement process?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the roof replacement process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The roof replacement process typically begins with a thorough inspection and detailed estimate. Once approved, the existing roofing materials are carefully removed down to the roof deck. Any damaged or rotted decking is repaired or replaced. Next, new underlayment is installed to provide an additional layer of protection. Finally, the new roofing material is installed according to manufacturer specifications and local building codes. The process concludes with a final inspection and thorough cleanup of the work area.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves inspection, removal of old roof, deck repair, underlayment installation, new roof installation, and cleanup.
